verses.saheeh: About what are they asking one another?
verses.khattab: What are they asking one another about
verses.jalalayn: ﻿About what, about what thing, are they, the people of Quraysh, questioning one another?

verses.saheeh: About the great news -
verses.khattab: About the momentous news
verses.jalalayn: ﻿About the awesome tiding ([this is] the explication of that ‘thing’; the interrogative is meant to emphasise its magnitude) — this [awesome tiding] is the Qur'an, comprising [news of] the Resurrection and so on, which the Prophet (s) brought —

verses.saheeh: That over which they are in disagreement.
verses.khattab: over which they disagree
verses.jalalayn: ﻿concerning which they are at variance, for the believers affirm it, while the disbelievers repudiate it.

verses.saheeh: No! They are going to know.
verses.khattab: But no! They will come to know
verses.jalalayn: ﻿No indeed! — a disavowal — they will come to know, what will befall them for their rejection of it.

verses.saheeh: Then, no! They are going to know.
verses.khattab: Again, no! They will come to know
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Again, no indeed! They will come to know! ([reiterated] for emphasis; thumma is added here to declare that the second threat of chastisement is more severe than the first). God, exalted be He, then alludes to His power to resurrect, saying:

verses.saheeh: Have We not made the earth a resting place?
verses.khattab: Have We not smoothed out the earth ˹like a bed˺
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Have We not made the earth a cradle, a bed, like a cradle,

verses.saheeh: And the mountains as stakes?
verses.khattab: and ˹made˺ the mountains as ˹its˺ pegs
verses.jalalayn: ﻿and the mountains pegs?, with which the earth is tied down like tents are tied down with pegs (the interrogative is meant as an affirmative).

verses.saheeh: And We created you in pairs
verses.khattab: and created you in pairs
verses.jalalayn: ﻿And created you in pairs?, males and females,

verses.saheeh: And made your sleep [a means for] rest
verses.khattab: and made your sleep for rest
verses.jalalayn: ﻿and made your sleep for rest?, repose for your bodies,

verses.saheeh: And made the night as clothing
verses.khattab: and made the night as a cover
verses.jalalayn: ﻿and made the night a cloak?, to cover you with its darkness,

verses.saheeh: And made the day for livelihood
verses.khattab: and made the day for livelihood
verses.jalalayn: ﻿and made the day for livelihood?, a time for seeking livelihood,

verses.saheeh: And constructed above you seven strong [heavens]
verses.khattab: and built above you seven mighty ˹heavens˺
verses.jalalayn: ﻿and built above you seven mighty ones?, seven heavens (shidād is the plural of shadīda) that is to say, strong and sturdy unaffected by the passage of time,

verses.saheeh: And made [therein] a burning lamp
verses.khattab: and placed ˹in them˺ a shining lamp
verses.jalalayn: ﻿and set a radiant lamp?, namely, the sun,

verses.saheeh: And sent down, from the rain clouds, pouring water
verses.khattab: and sent down from rainclouds pouring water
verses.jalalayn: ﻿and sent down from the rain-clouds (mu‘sirāt), the clouds due to give rain (similar to [the term] mu‘sir, which denotes a girl nearing menstruation) cascading water?, pouring forth,

verses.saheeh: That We may bring forth thereby grain and vegetation
verses.khattab: producing by it grain and ˹various˺ plants
verses.jalalayn: ﻿that with it We may bring forth grains, such as wheat, and plants, such as figs,

verses.saheeh: And gardens of entwined growth.
verses.khattab: and dense orchards
verses.jalalayn: ﻿and gardens, orchards, of intertwining foliage? (alfāf is the plural of lafīf, similar [in pattern] to sharīf, ‘noble’, [plural] ashrāf).

verses.saheeh: Indeed, the Day of Judgement is an appointed time -
verses.khattab: Indeed, the Day of ˹Final˺ Decision is an appointed time—
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Verily the Day of Decision, for creatures, is the tryst, a time [fixed] for reward and punishment,

verses.uthmani: يَوۡمَ يُنفَخُ فِي ٱلصُّورِ فَتَأۡتُونَ أَفۡوَاجٗا
verses.indopak: يَّوْمَ يُنْفَخُ فِى الصُّوْرِ فَتَأْتُوْنَ اَفْوَاجًاۙ
verses.transliteration: yawma yunfakhu fee alssoori fatatoona afwajan
verses.saheeh: The Day the Horn is blown and you will come forth in multitudes
verses.khattab: ˹it is˺ the Day the Trumpet will be blown, and you will ˹all˺ come forth in crowds
verses.jalalayn: ﻿the day the Trumpet, the Horn, is blown (yawma yunfakhu fī’l-sūri is either a substitution for, or an explication of, yawma’l-fasli, ‘the Day of Decision’, the blower being Isrāfīl) and you come, forth from your graves to the site [of the Resurrection], in droves, in diverse groups,

verses.saheeh: And the heaven is opened and will become gateways
verses.khattab: The sky will be ˹split˺ open, becoming ˹many˺ gates
verses.jalalayn: ﻿and the heaven is opened (read futtihat or futihat), sundered for the descent of the angels, and becomes as gates, it becomes [a heaven] with gates,

verses.saheeh: And the mountains are removed and will be [but] a mirage.
verses.khattab: and the mountains will be blown away, becoming ˹like˺ a mirage
verses.jalalayn: ﻿and the mountains are set in motion, dislocated from their positions, and become as a mirage, as fine dust, that is to say, like it in terms of its levity when in motion.

verses.saheeh: Indeed, Hell has been lying in wait
verses.khattab: Indeed, Hell is lying in ambush
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Verily Hell lurks in ambush (mirsādan, in the sense of rāsidatan or mursidatan, ‘lying in wait’)

verses.saheeh: For the transgressors, a place of return,
verses.khattab: as a home for the transgressors
verses.jalalayn: ﻿for the rebellious, the disbelievers, who will not be able to avoid it, [it is] a resort, a retreat for them, and so they will enter it,

verses.saheeh: In which they will remain for ages [unending].
verses.khattab: where they will remain for ˹endless˺ ages
verses.jalalayn: ﻿to remain (lābithīna is an implied circumstantial qualifier, in other words, their remaining therein will be decreed [to be]) therein for ages, for endless epochs (ahqāb is the plural of huqb),

verses.uthmani: لَّا يَذُوقُونَ فِيهَا بَرۡدٗا وَلَا شَرَابًا
verses.indopak: لَا يَذُوْقُوْنَ فِيْهَا بَرْدًا وَّلَا شَرَابًاۙ
verses.transliteration: la yathooqoona feeha bardan wala sharaban
verses.saheeh: They will not taste therein [any] coolness or drink
verses.khattab: There they will not taste any coolness or drink
verses.jalalayn: ﻿tasting in it neither coolness, [neither] sleep, [something] which they will not taste [therein], nor drink, [nor] anything that is imbibed for the sake of its delightful taste,

verses.saheeh: Except scalding water and [foul] purulence -
verses.khattab: except boiling water and ˹oozing˺ pus—
verses.jalalayn: ﻿except boiling water, of extreme temperatures, and pus (read ghasāqan or ghassāqan, which is the vile matter that is emitted by the [bodies of the] inhabitants of the Fire), which is what they will [indeed] taste. They are given this pair [of tortures],

verses.saheeh: An appropriate recompense.
verses.khattab: a fitting reward
verses.jalalayn: ﻿as a fitting requital, one that accords with [the nature of] their deeds, for there is no sin greater than disbelief, and no chastisement greater than the Fire.

verses.saheeh: Indeed, they were not expecting an account
verses.khattab: For they never expected any reckoning
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Indeed they never feared any reckoning, given their rejection of the Resurrection,

verses.saheeh: And denied Our verses with [emphatic] denial.
verses.khattab: and totally rejected Our signs
verses.jalalayn: ﻿and they denied Our signs, the Qur'an, mendaciously,

verses.saheeh: But all things We have enumerated in writing.
verses.khattab: And We have everything recorded precisely
verses.jalalayn: ﻿and everything, in the way of deeds, have We kept count of, have We recorded precisely, in a Book, as [individual] written records in the Preserved Tablet, in order to requite [creatures] in accordance with them, including [the record of] their denial of the Qur'an.

verses.saheeh: "So taste [the penalty], and never will We increase you except in torment."
verses.khattab: ˹So the deniers will be told,˺ “Taste ˹the punishment˺, for all you will get from Us is more torment.”
verses.jalalayn: ﻿‘So [now] taste! — in other words, it will be said to them in the Hereafter, when the chastisement has befallen them: taste [now] your requital! For We will increase you in nothing but chastisement’, in addition to your [due] chastisement.

verses.saheeh: Indeed, for the righteous is attainment -
verses.khattab: Indeed, the righteous will have salvation—
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Truly for the God-fearing there will be a triumph, a place of triumph, in Paradise:

verses.saheeh: Gardens and grapevines
verses.khattab: Gardens, vineyards
verses.jalalayn: ﻿gardens, orchards (hadā’iqa is either a substitution for, or an explication of, mafāzan, ‘a triumph’) and vineyards (wa-a‘nāban is a supplement to mafāzan, ‘a triumph’),

verses.saheeh: And full-breasted [companions] of equal age
verses.khattab: and full-bosomed maidens of equal age
verses.jalalayn: ﻿and buxom maidens (kawā‘ib is the plural of kā‘ib) of equal age (atrāb is the plural of tirb),

verses.saheeh: And a full cup.
verses.khattab: and full cups ˹of pure wine˺
verses.jalalayn: ﻿and a brimming cup, wine filling the vessels in which it is in; in sūrat al-Qitāl [it is said], and rivers of wine [Q. 47:15].

verses.uthmani: لَّا يَسۡمَعُونَ فِيهَا لَغۡوٗا وَلَا كِذَّٰبٗا
verses.indopak: لَا يَسْمَعُوْنَ فِيْهَا لَـغْوًا وَّلَا كِذّٰبًاۚ
verses.transliteration: la yasma'oona feeha laghwan wala kiththaban
verses.saheeh: No ill speech will they hear therein or any falsehood -
verses.khattab: never to hear any idle talk or lying therein—
verses.jalalayn: ﻿They will not hear in it, that is, [in] Paradise, when they drink wine and in other situations, any vain talk, any words of falsehood, or lies, between one another (read kidhāban, to mean kadhiban, ‘lies’, or kidhdhāban to mean takdhīban, ‘lying’), in contrast to what happens in this world when wine is drunk,

verses.saheeh: [As] reward from your Lord, [a generous] gift [made due by] account,
verses.khattab: a ˹fitting˺ reward as a generous gift from your Lord
verses.jalalayn: ﻿[this will be] a reward from your Lord, in other words, God has rewarded them with this reward as, a gift (‘atā’an substitutes for jazā’an, ‘reward’) that is sufficing, [that is] abundant (hisāban, [as meaning ‘abundant’] derives from their saying a‘tānī fa-ahsabanī, ‘he gave me so abundantly that I said, “that is enough for me”’ [hasbī]),

verses.uthmani: رَّبِّ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَمَا بَيۡنَهُمَا ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنِۖلَا يَمۡلِكُونَ مِنۡهُ خِطَابٗا
verses.indopak: رَّبِّ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالْاَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا الرَّحْمٰنِ لَا يَمْلِكُوْنَ مِنْهُ خِطَابًاۚ
verses.transliteration: rabbi alssamawati waalardi wama baynahuma alrrahmani la yamlikoona minhu khitaban
verses.saheeh: [From] the Lord of the heavens and the earth and whatever is between them, the Most Merciful. They possess not from Him [authority for] speech.
verses.khattab: the Lord of the heavens and the earth and everything in between, the Most Compassionate. No one will dare speak to Him
verses.jalalayn: ﻿[from] the Lord of the heavens and the earth (read rabbi, ‘[from] the Lord of’, or rabbu, ‘[He is] the Lord of’) and all that is between them, the Compassionate One (likewise [read rahmāni or rahmānu], or read rahmānu with rabbi [for the preceding]), Whom, exalted be He, they, that is, creatures, will not be able to address, that is to say, not one of them will be able to address Him for fear of Him,

verses.uthmani: يَوۡمَ يَقُومُ ٱلرُّوحُ وَٱلۡمَلَٰٓئِكَةُ صَفّٗاۖلَّا يَتَكَلَّمُونَ إِلَّا مَنۡ أَذِنَ لَهُ ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنُ وَقَالَ صَوَابٗا
verses.indopak: يَوْمَ يَقُوْمُ الرُّوْحُ وَالْمَلٰۤٮِٕكَةُ صَفًّاۙلَّا يَتَكَلَّمُوْنَ اِلَّا مَنْ اَذِنَ لَهُ الرَّحْمٰنُ وَقَالَ صَوَابًا
verses.transliteration: yawma yaqoomu alrroohu waalmalaikatu saffan la yatakallamoona illa man athina lahu alrrahmanu waqala sawaban
verses.saheeh: The Day that the Spirit and the angels will stand in rows, they will not speak except for one whom the Most Merciful permits, and he will say what is correct.
verses.khattab: on the Day the ˹holy˺ spirit and the angels will stand in ranks. None will talk, except those granted permission by the Most Compassionate and whose words are true
verses.jalalayn: ﻿on the day (yawma is the adverbial qualifier for lā yamlikūna, ‘they will not be able to’) when the Spirit, Gabriel, or God’s hosts, and the angels stand arrayed (saffan is a circumstantial qualifier, in other words, mustaffīna). They, creatures, will not speak, except him whom the Compassionate One permits, to speak, and who says what is right, from among the believers and the angels: as if [meaning] that they will intercede for he whom He approves of.

verses.uthmani: ذَٰلِكَ ٱلۡيَوۡمُ ٱلۡحَقُّۖفَمَن شَآءَ ٱتَّخَذَ إِلَىٰ رَبِّهِۦ مَـَٔابًا
verses.indopak: ذٰلِكَ الْيَوْمُ الْحَـقُّۚفَمَنْ شَاۤءَ اتَّخَذَ اِلٰى رَبِّهٖ مَاٰبًا
verses.transliteration: thalika alyawmu alhaqqu faman shaa ittakhatha ila rabbihi maaban
verses.saheeh: That is the True Day; so he who wills may take to his Lord a [way of] return.
verses.khattab: That Day is the ˹ultimate˺ truth. So let whoever wills take the path leading back to their Lord
verses.jalalayn: ﻿That is the True Day, whose coming to pass is definite, namely, the Day of Resurrection. So whoever wishes [to], let him seek resort with his Lord, a return [to Him], that is to say, [let him] return to God by being obedient to Him, so that he may be secure from chastisement in it.

verses.uthmani: إِنَّآ أَنذَرۡنَٰكُمۡ عَذَابٗا قَرِيبٗا يَوۡمَ يَنظُرُ ٱلۡمَرۡءُ مَا قَدَّمَتۡ يَدَاهُ وَيَقُولُ ٱلۡكَافِرُ يَٰلَيۡتَنِي كُنتُ تُرَٰبَۢا
verses.indopak: اِنَّاۤ اَنْذَرْنٰـكُمْ عَذَابًا قَرِيْبًاۙيَّوْمَ يَنْظُرُ الْمَرْءُ مَا قَدَّمَتْ يَدٰهُ وَيَقُوْلُ الْـكٰفِرُ يٰلَيْتَنِىْ كُنْتُ تُرٰبًا٪
verses.transliteration: inna antharnakum 'athaban qareeban yawma yanthuru almaro ma qaddamat yadahu wayaqoolu alkafiru ya laytanee kuntu turaban
verses.saheeh: Indeed, We have warned you of a near punishment on the Day when a man will observe what his hands have put forth and the disbeliever will say, "Oh, I wish that I were dust!"
verses.khattab: Indeed, We have warned you of an imminent punishment—the Day every person will see ˹the consequences of˺ what their hands have done, and the disbelievers will cry, “I wish I were dust.”
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Lo! We have warned you, O disbelievers of Mecca, of a chastisement that is near, the chastisement of the impending Day of Resurrection — for anything that is impending is [also] near — the day (yawma adverbially qualifies ‘adhāban, ‘a chastisement’, by describing it) when a person, [when] every person, will behold what his hands have sent ahead, of good and evil, and the disbeliever will say, ‘O (yā is a particle used to call attention to something) would that I were dust!’, in other words, and not be chastised. He says this when God, exalted be He, says to the beasts, after each of them has retaliated against the other, ‘Be dust!’.
